narrative.overview: StarkCircom feels like a precise launch instrument rather than a generic dashboard. One controlled sequence stays central, evidence remains adjacent, and Starknet coral appears only where attention or action is required.
keyCharacteristics: A single operational runbook as the main spatial spine.
Adjacent evidence for authority, balances, addresses, and receipts.
Cool instrument surfaces with sparse coral emphasis.
Monospace text only for technical labels, hashes, counts, and status details.
Semantic colors reserved for confirmed, warning, and stopped states.

rules.name: The One Live Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral identifies the current operation only. Completed steps use green and waiting steps stay neutral.

rules.name: The Semantic Reserve Rule
rules.body: Green means confirmed, amber means attention, and red means stopped. These colors are not decorative.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when the content is machine-shaped or operational. Explanations stay in the sans-serif face.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Evidence rows and status areas use borders and surface shifts, not independent floating shadows.

dos: Do make the next owner-approved operation the strongest control on the screen.
Do place transaction hashes, deployed addresses, and readback evidence near the launch sequence.
Do keep wrong-network, unfunded, pending, rejected, failed, and confirmed states visibly distinct.
Do preserve explicit language about local witnesses and synthetic manufacturer data.
donts: Don't turn each deployment fact into a generic dashboard card.
Don't use coral across completed or passive content.
Don't hide wallet authority or imply that the app signs transactions.
Don't present a deployment as complete without confirmed receipts and state readback.
Don't add decorative gradients, glow effects, or oversized icons.
